description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::gaussian_distribution class, including serialization, statistical validation, and implementation-specific behavior tests.

classes.name: GaussianModel
classes.description: A model class representing a Gaussian distribution with methods for mean, variance, stddev, skewness, kurtosis, and inverse CDF.

classes.name: GaussianDistributionTests
classes.description: A test fixture class implementing statistical tests for the gaussian_distribution, including z-tests and chi-squared tests.

methods.name: SerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of the gaussian_distribution object.

methods.name: SingleZTest
methods.description: Performs a z-test on generated data to validate distribution correctness.

methods.name: SingleChiSquaredTest
methods.description: Performs a chi-squared goodness-of-fit test on the distribution.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Structure holding parameters for distribution tests, including mean, stddev, failure probability, and trials.

methods.name: ParamName
methods.description: Generates a string name for test parameters for identification.
